items.quote: Jehoiada brought out the king’s son and put the crown on him; he presented him with a copy of the covenant
items.contrast: Jehoiada is the giver, while the king’s son is the recipient.
items.reason: The pronouns continue the stated relationship: “he” refers to Jehoiada and “him” to the king’s son. The question clearly asks for the giver, so the key is fully supported.
